items.text: Senior Data Engineer with 6.5 years of experience architecting distributed batch and streaming ETL pipelines, lakehouse tables, and dimensional data warehouses using Python, Scala, Apache Spark, Airflow, and dbt.

entries.heading: Senior Data Engineer | Crestline Logistics & Freight | 2021 – Present

items.text: Designed and operated distributed batch and micro-batch streaming ETL pipelines in Python, Scala, and Apache Spark (Databricks / Delta Lake) processing 9TB of daily shipment telemetry.
Architected and maintained 160+ production DAGs in Apache Airflow with KubernetesPodOperators, SLA miss callbacks, and idempotent historical backfill workflows.
Modeled core enterprise finance and supply-chain Kimball star schemas (Type-2 Slowly Changing Dimensions and conformed fact tables) in Snowflake using modular dbt transformations.
Streamed row-level binlog events from 24 production MySQL and Postgres shards into Kafka using Debezium CDC connectors with sub-5-second warehouse landing latency.

Salted hot merchant partition keys, broadcast 40MB lookup dimensions, and enabled Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) across a 1.8PB clickstream join, eliminating executor container kills and cutting runtime from 4.2 hours to 38 minutes.

Embedded Great Expectations null/uniqueness assertions and OpenLineage upstream impact graphs into every staging-to-mart promotion gate, blocking 28 malformed vendor payloads before they reached executive dashboards.

Cut monthly Snowflake credit consumption by 34% ($29K/mo) by right-sizing virtual warehouse auto-suspend timers, pruning unused staging clones, and re-clustering multi-billion-row order tables on event date.
Coached 3 mid-level data engineers through architectural reviews and co-authored the company's canonical naming and table ownership handbook with BI and data science leads.
Migrated 400+ legacy S3 Parquet tables to Apache Iceberg with hidden partitioning and snapshot time-travel, enabling GDPR right-to-be-forgotten deletes without full table rewrites.
Built daily point-of-sale ingestion and inventory reconciliation pipelines in PySpark and Scala Spark on AWS EMR across 1,400 retail locations.
Automated dbt Cloud CI jobs on GitHub pull requests using slim state comparison (state:modified+) to validate schema changes against zero-copy Snowflake dev clones.
Implemented PII column masking policies and role-based access control (RBAC) in Snowflake for CCPA and HIPAA compliance audits.
Constructed a Spark Structured Streaming pipeline consuming Kafka point-of-sale topics to update regional stockout alerts every 60 seconds.
Replaced fragile cron shell scripts on EC2 with version-controlled Airflow DAGs and PagerDuty failure alerts, improving daily 8 AM warehouse SLA attainment from 84% to 99.4%.
Maintained warehouse service-account read grants and network allowlists for downstream Looker and Power BI analyst groups.
Applied digital watermark metadata tags to exported PDF vendor invoices for accounts-payable compliance archival.
Evaluated Apache Flink vs Spark Structured Streaming in a 3-page architecture RFC (team standardized on Spark Structured Streaming; Flink was not adopted).
Coordinated with server room facilities to balance cold-aisle HVAC airflow across legacy on-prem racks prior to AWS cloud migration.
Sparked a quarterly cross-team data literacy brown-bag series for 50+ commercial operations analysts.
Wrote Python scripts to parse EDIFACT and X12 supply-chain flat files from maritime freight carriers into staging S3 buckets.
